title: ROHL U.3243 1-1/4" Extension Kit for Wall Mount Concealed Valves

comparisons.notes: Same ROHL U.3243 one-piece solid brass valve extension kit
Same Perrin & Rowe/ROHL U.3243 extension kit

writeup: This is ROHL's U.3243, a solid brass, one-piece 1-1/4-inch extension that brings recessed Perrin & Rowe concealed wall valves forward to the finished wall. It fits volume controls like the U.3230, U.3240 and U.3793 plus some wall-mount diverters. PlumbersStock sells it for $49.29 and Ferguson for $68.
amazon_match_notes: Amazon listing B005F25L0M is the ROHL U.3243 extension kit (same ASIN as Woot offer data)
